intro: Lesson 29: Bridge writing: instructions for a dough moon rock. Plan or write in each box.

parts.text: Teacher works this one aloud: read the question, underline the key words, link it to today's rule, then give the answer in a full sentence: 1. Take some dough. 2. Roll a ball. 3. Poke holes.
